preamble.title: GodOfAgents/vams-cardano
preamble.description: VAMS Brain Layer — Cardano governance, insurance, and agent identity validators

cardano/address/Address.title: Address
cardano/address/Address.description:
A Cardano `Address` typically holding one or two credential references.

 Note that legacy bootstrap addresses (a.k.a. 'Byron addresses') are
 completely excluded from Plutus contexts. Thus, from an on-chain
 perspective only exists addresses of type 00, 01, ..., 07 as detailed
 in [CIP-0019 :: Shelley Addresses](https://github.com/cardano-foundation/CIPs/tree/master/CIP-0019/#shelley-addresses).

cardano/address/Credential.title: Credential
cardano/address/Credential.description:
A general structure for representing an on-chain `Credential`.

 Credentials are always one of two kinds: a direct public/private key
 pair, or a script (native or Plutus).

cardano/address/PaymentCredential.title: PaymentCredential
cardano/address/PaymentCredential.description:
A general structure for representing an on-chain `Credential`.

 Credentials are always one of two kinds: a direct public/private key
 pair, or a script (native or Plutus).

cardano/address/StakeCredential.title: StakeCredential
cardano/address/StakeCredential.description:
Represent a type of object that can be represented either inline (by hash)
 or via a reference (i.e. a pointer to an on-chain location).

 This is mainly use for capturing pointers to a stake credential
 registration certificate in the case of so-called pointer addresses.

cardano/transaction/OutputReference.title: OutputReference
cardano/transaction/OutputReference.description:
An `OutputReference` is a unique reference to an output on-chain. The `output_index`
 corresponds to the position in the output list of the transaction (identified by its id)
 that produced that output

vams/f05_authority/AuthorityPendingTrans.title: AuthorityPendingTransitionV3
vams/f05_authority/AuthorityPendingTrans.description:
The pending data is kept in the singleton datum and canonically hashed into
 AuthorityStateV3. NONE uses the R4 all-zero encoding and zero pending hash.

vams/f05_authority/AuthorityStateV3.title: AuthorityStateV3
vams/f05_authority/AuthorityStateV3.description: Field values correspond to CONTRACT.json authority_preimages.state_fields.

vams/types/AgentDatumV1.title: AgentDatumV1
vams/types/AgentDatumV1.description:
On-chain agent record datum (one UTXO per agent)
 Versioned on-chain agent record datum (one UTXO per agent).

 This is the only accepted registry datum shape. The field order is frozen
 by the M3 F04 identity contract; legacy eight-field datums are not
 represented and cannot be decoded by the registry boundary.

vams/types/ClaimRecord.title: ClaimRecord
vams/types/ClaimRecord.description: Durable claim state carried by the singleton fund output.

vams/types/GovernanceConfigV1.title: GovernanceConfigV1
vams/types/GovernanceConfigV1.description:
Frozen M3.2b governance configuration committed by the singleton genesis
 output. The list fields are deliberately bounded by the validators.

vams/types/InsuranceFundRedeemer.title: InsuranceFundRedeemer
vams/types/InsuranceFundRedeemer.description: Redeemer actions for the InsuranceFund validator

vams/types/RegistryRedeemerV1.title: RegistryRedeemerV1
vams/types/RegistryRedeemerV1.description:
Versioned registry transition redeemers. Numeric tags and field order are
 frozen by IDENTITY_SPEC.json; no legacy defaults or coercions are allowed.

vams/types/TimelockRedeemer.title: TimelockRedeemer
vams/types/TimelockRedeemer.description: Redeemers for the timelock state machine.
